admin.moderation.agree: They agree on how many moves each player made.
admin.moderation.alarm.card: played a card of the opponent's deck (server check)
admin.moderation.alarm.deck: deck not legal for the mode (server check)
admin.moderation.alarm.mana: played more than the turn's Energy allows (server check)
admin.moderation.bannedThroughAccount: Banned through the site account {name} - unban it in the list above
admin.moderation.bansHelp: For players without a site account, or to ban a game player on its own. A banned player cannot sign in, and a game already running stops working at its next request. Players whose site account is banned (above) are listed here too; unban those above.
admin.moderation.bansHelpAccounts: Every player signs in with a site account, so to ban someone, set their account to Banned in the list above: they cannot sign in, and a game already running stops working at its next request. Everyone who is banned is listed here. A game player banned on its own (from before accounts were required) can be unbanned here; the others are unbanned above.
admin.moderation.chatHelp: Messages players reported with Report message in the game's global chat. Checked means the server still had the message and it matches; otherwise the text is what the reporter's game showed. To act on a report, ban the account on the People page (or its game player below). Done takes a report off this list.
admin.moderation.checkHelp: What each player's own game recorded, against what that game actually sent through the server. A difference means a recording was changed, or a game recorded something it never sent.
admin.moderation.closeAsk: Close {id}? What was done (optional, only admins see it):
admin.moderation.disagree: They DISAGREE on how many moves each player made: one game recorded something the other did not see.
admin.moderation.findPlayer: Find a player (name, friend code or id)
admin.moderation.foundByServer: Found by the server in its record of the match: {alarm}
admin.moderation.noCardNames: Card names are missing: the recording was made by a mod older than 0.13.39, so cards show as numbers.
admin.moderation.noMatchRecord: no server record of the match
admin.moderation.noRecording: No recording of this match was found (a recording goes when its match leaves the player's battle log, unless it was reported first).
admin.moderation.noServerRecord: The server has no record of this match (matches against the AI, matches before the records started, or one that has expired).
admin.moderation.nothingToCheck: Nothing to check: the server has no record of this match, or no recording was kept.
admin.moderation.nothingToWatch: No recording of this match to watch.
admin.moderation.oneKept: Only one player's recording was kept.
admin.moderation.playersHelp: Players reported with REPORT in a game's battle log, and automatic reports from the game's anti-cheat (it notices a game's memory being edited or the game being sped up; it only reports, it never blocks anyone). Review shows the match: the moves both players' games recorded, the server's own record of the match, and the reporter's game log if they sent it. Evidence is kept while the report is open and 30 days after it is done. Ban player bans the game player; with site accounts, ban the account on the People page instead.
admin.moderation.raisedBy: Raised by the reported player's own game: {alarm}
admin.moderation.recordOpened: Record {id}, opened {time} UTC. Joins and drops:
admin.moderation.recordingsChecked: Recordings checked against the server's record
admin.moderation.unread: {count} message(s) in the server's record could not be read.
admin.moderation.watchHelp: Copy a code, then in the game press Watch a replay code under Settings > Mod. Each recording shows the match from that player's side. These codes belong to the report: they are not on the players' Profile pages.
admin.moderation.wordsHelp: Words blocked in chat (starred out) and in player and account names (refused). One per line; capitals do not matter, and look-alike spellings (sh1t, f.u.c.k, fuuuck) are caught. word blocks the whole word only, word* any word starting with it, *word* it anywhere, even inside other words (careful: that catches innocent words too). Names chosen before a word was added are not changed.
admin.moderation.wordsStarting: {count} entries: the server's starting list. Saving makes it this server's own list.
admin.moderation.wordsTryPlaceholder: type something to see what the filter does
admin.people.autoApprove: New accounts are approved automatically for now.
admin.people.deleteText: The account is signed out everywhere now and deleted in 7 days unless someone signs in to it (or you press Keep account).
admin.people.deleteTip: Signs the account out everywhere and deletes it after 7 days (signing in again cancels it)
admin.people.help: Every account that has been let in (accounts still waiting are on the Requests page). Only admins can change these. Reviewer: approves and rejects cards waiting for review. In-game tester: will get custom cards in the game before release. Admin: everything, including this page. Site access: whether the account may use this site and play on the game server. A banned account cannot sign in to either, and the game player linked to it is banned too.
admin.people.notLinked: Not linked to a game player
admin.people.onlyFounder: Only the founding owner can give or take owner
admin.people.onlyOwner: Only an owner can give or take admin
admin.people.resetCodeTip: Makes a one-time code this person can use to set a new password (sign-in page > Forgot your password?)
admin.people.resetMade: {name}: reset code made. Pass it on privately.
admin.people.resetMessage1: Your Warpforge Revival password reset code: {code}
admin.people.resetMessage2: On the website's sign-in page choose "Forgot your password?", enter your username ({name}), this code and a new password. It works once, until {time}. Afterwards, make your own recovery code on your Profile page.
admin.people.resetReplaces: The code made earlier stops working.
admin.people.resetWaiting: Reset code waiting (made by {name}, works until {time})
admin.people.resetWarning: Anyone with the code and the username can take over the account, so only give it to the account's owner, privately (a direct message, never a public channel). Check first that it is really them.
admin.people.resetWorks: Works once, for {hours} hours (until {time}). It is shown only now: copy it before closing this box. Using it signs the account out everywhere; its own recovery code, if it has one, keeps working.
admin.people.signOutGameTip: Signs this account out of the game on every computer and Android device. It keeps its game player.
admin.people.signedOutGame: signed out of the game everywhere
admin.people.waitApproval: New accounts wait as “requested” until an admin approves them.
admin.requests.approveAllAsk: Approve all {count} account(s) shown on this page?
admin.requests.autoApprove: New accounts are approved automatically for now, so new ones do not wait here.
admin.requests.declineAsk: Decline {name}? The account is deleted in 7 days unless someone signs in to it.
admin.requests.declineTip: Signs the account out and deletes it after 7 days
admin.requests.help: Accounts waiting for access, oldest first. Approve lets the account use this site and play on the game server. Decline signs it out and deletes it after 7 days, as Delete does on the People page (signing in again within those days cancels that, and the account waits here again).
admin.server.jsonHelp: Everything in both files, including what the forms above do not show. Each save keeps the previous file in data/config-history/ on the server (the last 30 of each).
admin.server.loadFailed: Could not load the server settings: {error}
admin.server.mode.addedManaSecond: Extra mana per turn, second player
admin.server.mode.offenseCards: Offence cards (the battlefield card pick before a match)
admin.server.mode.secondPlayerExtraCards: Extra starting cards for the second player
admin.server.modesHelp: Match rules for each game mode (content/liveops/GameModes.json). Players get changes the next time they start the game. An empty box means the game's own default. If you change how matches play, also raise the Rules version below: players are only matched with the same rules, and saved replays from older rules stop loading.
admin.server.needPassword: enter your password at the top of the page
admin.server.passwordHelp: Changing the server needs your password as well as being signed in, so a sign-in left on another computer cannot change it.
admin.server.protectionOff: You are turning off protection: {list}. Anyone who can reach the server is then trusted more. Save anyway?
admin.server.set.autoApproveHint: Off: you approve each one on the People page.
admin.server.set.longGameClassicDeckSize: Long Game: size of a Classic deck it is built from
admin.server.set.minModVersionHint: "latest" means the build this server hands out.
admin.server.set.offenseCardsHint: Newer mods use each game mode's own Offence cards switch (Game modes, above).
admin.server.set.requireAccount: Require a site account to play
admin.server.set.requireAccountHint: Keep on for any server strangers can reach.
admin.server.set.rulesVersionHint: Raise it whenever match rules or cards change.
admin.server.settingsHelp: From content/files/revival-settings.json. Most take effect straight away; players' games pick up game rules the next time they start.
admin.unreleased.help: Cards that only exist as text in the game: names and rules text Everguild wrote but never turned into card data, so they were never playable. Unreleased ones were still being made (mostly Emperor's Children and Goff Orks); old versions are earlier wordings of cards that changed. Taken from the game's own English text. Ideas for custom cards.
admin.unreleased.loadFailed: Could not load the unreleased cards: {error}
admin.unreleased.noText: No rules text in the game, only the name.
admin.uploads.deleteAsk: Delete the artwork of “{name}” by {author} for good?
admin.uploads.deleteReason: Reason (shown to the author if the card was submitted):
admin.uploads.help: Every picture stored on the server, drafts included, newest first. Delete removes the picture and its mask from the server for good; a card that was waiting for review or approved goes back to its author as rejected.
art.changeOnProfile: change it on your Profile page
art.fromExport: Official frames and card art: from your game's export (kept in this browser)
art.fromExportText: Official frames, card art and card text: from your game's export (kept in this browser)
art.fromYourGame: Official card names, rules text, frames and art come from your own copy of the game, not from this site – without them cards show their ids.
art.loadOnProfile: Load them on your Profile page
bugs.attachmentsRemoved: The log, screenshot and crash dump were removed {date}, 30 days after this report was closed.
bugs.descriptionLabel: What happened, steps to make it happen again
bugs.howTo: How to report a bug (testers): in the game press F8 (PC) or Report bug in the Testers window right when it happens: the screenshot and log are taken at that moment. One bug per report; the title says what went wrong ("Bolter Brother dealt 0 damage to a warlord"), not the cause. Check this list first: if it is already here, still send a short report and put the other report's number in the title ("same as B-0042") — your device and version are what we need. If the game crashes or freezes, just start it again: it offers to send a report with everything saved at the time.
bugs.loadFailed: Could not load the bug reports: {error}
bugs.noAttachments: No screenshot or log was sent with this report.
bugs.title: Bug reports
creator.actionAbilityHead: When it is used ({trigger}): what else happens
creator.actionNoteReviewer: Limits or conditions (optional, for the reviewer)
creator.advancedHelp: Show advanced options – settings only a few official cards use (timing, leftovers, card settings). Off, the editor shows only what the game uses for your choices.
creator.agreeRules: This card follows all of the {link}.
creator.allWritten: Everything in this design was written into the game data.
creator.alsoShownAs: Also shown as {keyword} (a second ability under the same keyword).
creator.alternativeHelp: used instead of the action above while a condition is not met (as Wulfen Pack Leader)
creator.alternativeWhen: The card uses its action above while this condition is met, and this action otherwise.
creator.art.belowCardS: Below it the card's text box begins, so the bottom strip is hidden.
creator.art.blankMaskallBlack:
Blank maskAll black, 1024 × 1024. Paint white on it.
{link}
creator.art.cardCreatorFill: In the card creator, fill in the card, then choose …or upload your own artwork.
creator.art.cardSName: The card's name and rules text can start about here. The picture carries on behind the text but is darkened. Short text starts lower, so the picture should still look good down there.
creator.art.coveredByFaction: Covered by the faction badge, cost, attack values, armour and health.
creator.art.dragZoomPicture: Drag and zoom the picture under the guides (the same guides as the templates), then Use this artwork.
creator.art.edgeCardFrame: The edge of the card. The frame covers a thin band just inside it.
creator.art.everyCardS: Every card's art is one 1024 × 1024 picture. Bring any size or shape: the card creator's editor crops and scales it for you.
creator.art.everythingOneFileboth:
Everything in one fileBoth templates, the blank mask, the example sheet and this guide.
{link}
creator.art.fourOfficialCards: Four official cards, showing the picture in the art file, the pop-out mask stored with it, and the finished card.
creator.art.maskMustLine: The mask must line up with the picture as saved by the creator. The safe way: place and save the artwork in the creator first, then paint the mask over that saved 1024 × 1024 picture.
creator.art.measurementsWereTaken: Measurements were taken by lining official art up against finished official cards. Example artwork belongs to its owners and is shown for reference only.
creator.art.noMaskMeans: No mask means everything stays neatly inside the frame. That is fine, and it is the default.
creator.art.officialCardsLet: Official cards let part of the figure overlap the frame. That is controlled by a second picture of the same size: white where the art should be drawn on top of the frame, black everywhere else. Soft grey edges give a soft blend.
creator.art.onlyUploadArtwork: Only upload artwork you made or have the right to use, and follow the {link}.
creator.art.outsideCardOnly: Outside the card. Only seen where the pop-out mask says so.
creator.art.partsBreakOut: Parts that break out over the card frame (a gun barrel, a banner) are optional and come from a second picture, the pop-out mask.
creator.art.pictureArea670: The picture area: 670 pixels wide (x 177 to 847), the full 1024 high. Fill all of it. Nothing outside it is used.
creator.art.pngJpgOr: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 20 MB. The creator saves it as a 1024 × 1024 PNG.
creator.art.shownAtFull: Shown at full brightness. Put the face or focal point here.
creator.art.startFromArt: Start from art-mask-blank.png and paint white over the part that should break out. Keep it small: a weapon, a hand, a crest. The official cards pop out one or two details, not the whole figure.
creator.art.templatesAreSee: The templates are see-through. In your paint program, open a template, put your picture on a layer underneath it, line the picture up, then hide the template layer before you export.
creator.art.topRightCorner: Top right corner: covered by the faction badge and the cost.
creator.art.troopsVehiclesWarlords: Troops, vehicles and warlords use a tall painting, background included, in the middle of that square. It does not need a transparent background.
creator.art.unitOptionallyChoose: For a unit, optionally choose Add a pop-out mask and pick your mask picture.
creator.art.unitPicturesAre: Unit pictures are portrait (about 2 : 3). A landscape picture will be cropped hard at the sides.
creator.art.unitTemplatetroopsVehicles:
Unit templateTroops, vehicles, warlords. See-through overlay with the guides.
{link}
creator.art.unitsAimAt: For units aim for at least 670 × 1024; for stratagems at least 1024 × 1024. Smaller pictures are enlarged and look soft.
creator.art.wholeSquarePicture: The whole square is the picture. Fill all of it.
creator.artBorrow: Artwork – borrow from an existing card
creator.artDragHelp: Drag the picture to move it; the mouse wheel zooms.
creator.artGuideLine: {link} – sizes, what the card covers, and how the pop-out mask works.
creator.artHelpStratagem: Stratagem art fills the whole square, and nearly all of it is shown. Red marks are covered by the card's icons and text box.
creator.artHelpUnit: Troop, vehicle and warlord art is a full painting, background included, in the gold box. The card shows the top part clearly and darkens the rest behind its text, so keep the face or focal point in the clear zone. Red marks are covered by the card's icons.
creator.artPlaceSize: saved as 1024 × 1024, the size the game uses
creator.artRemoveConfirm: Remove the uploaded artwork from this card?
creator.artSmall: That picture is only {w} × {h}; it will look soft when enlarged to the game's size.
creator.artStateBorrowed: Borrowed art is chosen – saving will drop the uploaded picture.
creator.artTooBig: That picture is over 20 MB – use a smaller one.
creator.artType: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP picture.
creator.artUnreadable: That picture could not be opened.
creator.buffFromHelp: "From" takes the number from the game instead of the box (the target's attack, this card's health, ...). Random ± adds or takes away up to that much.
creator.buffOtherPartsHelp: Parts of other kinds of buff (official cards sometimes carry them with this one):
creator.buffTypeDefault: Stats, a keyword or a cost change (as filled in)
creator.buildNoteCount: {n} build note(s) – open the card to read them
creator.cardListLoadFailed: Could not load the card list: {error}
creator.cardWhoseEffectItSetsOff: Card whose effect it sets off
creator.choicesHelp: The player picks one of the offered cards; effects aimed at “choice resolution” act on it. To offer set cards, keep “choice resolution” and list them under More filters → Only these cards.
creator.condCount: a count of cards or units compares to a number
creator.contextDefault: in play (or as official cards do)
creator.countEach: Repeat the effects once for each …
creator.createdNotCollection: Created by other cards (not in the collection)
creator.creditArtistPlaceholder: who made the picture (your name if it is yours)
creator.creditHelp: Saved with the uploaded picture itself, not only with this card. Only upload art you made, or art whose artist gave you permission – a credit alone is not permission.
creator.creditLinkPlaceholder: https://… the original post or the artist's page
creator.creditSaved: Artwork credit saved with the picture.
creator.deadTrigger: this trigger never fires in the game
creator.designSummary: The card as a creator design (what Load in editor fills in)
creator.discardConfirm: Discard {name}? It disappears from your list.
creator.enchantmentBuffHelp: An enchantment is a hidden card whose abilities act on the card it is attached to. Pick an official one, or one of your own cards marked "This card is an enchantment".
creator.enchantmentHelp: This card is an enchantment: a hidden card that other cards attach with an "Attach an enchantment" buff. It is never played itself; its abilities act on the card it is attached to (its cost, stats and text are not used). Official enchantments are stratagems.
creator.exStatic: It works by itself (look at CardTraits).
creator.examplesHelp: Pick a keyword to see official cards that use it, exactly as the game's card file stores them. Fields a card leaves empty are hidden, and numbers that stand for something are shown with their name, like rally (10). The simplest cards are listed first.
creator.factionHelp: The game does not forbid it, but faction mechanics often rely on that faction's own rules (its warlords, resources or other cards), so it may do nothing outside its faction.
creator.filtersRarelyNeededHelp: Most cards leave these empty for this group; a few official cards set them.
creator.gameData: Game data (the card as the game stores it)
creator.gameDataSummary: The data the game uses (from the game's card file; empty fields left out, numbers with their names)
creator.goSecondCard: Card given to this warlord when going second
creator.groupCommon: Used by 10 or more official cards
creator.groupFew: Used by a few official cards
creator.groupUntested: Untested – no official card uses it
creator.groupUnused: In the engine, unused by official cards
creator.handCardsToChange: The cards in hand to change
creator.handTargetsHelp: The cards in hand are a different set from the effect's target above
creator.hint.agenda: Agenda: a plain action like Duty. Official Dark Angels cards usually also gain quest points in it (Gain or lose energy, resource quest points).
creator.hint.ferocity: Ferocity: the troop does this and then returns to your deck – the game handles the return, so only add the effect itself.
creator.hint.oath: Oath: the number is written on the Oath keyword, as on the official Ultramarines cards (shown as "Oath 2: ...").
creator.hint.pray: Pray: add only what the prayer does. The step that sets off Pray (for cards that react to a friendly prayer) and the praying state are added automatically, as on the official Sororitas cards.
creator.keywordIsAction: This keyword is an action the player uses.
creator.keywordListLoadFailed: Could not load the keyword list: {error}
creator.keywordNumber: Number (a few official cards set one)
creator.keywordsHelp: Static keywords work by themselves (Flying, Stealth). Ability keywords say when something happens (Rally, Strike, Slay) and open a box for what happens. Action keywords (Duty, Pray, Oath, Agenda, Ferocity) are something the player uses during their turn; a card has at most one. Custom is an ability without a keyword: you pick when it happens. The number after a name is how many official cards use it.
creator.kwHelp: What each keyword does, in short. Wording is taken from the unofficial fan rulebook (Warpforge Offline Rulebook 1.5) and shortened; where a card's own text differs, the card wins. X is a number printed on the card.
creator.kwMissing: Used by official cards but not described in the rulebook: {list}.
creator.kwSearchPlaceholder: keyword or any word in its description
creator.linkScheme: The link must start with http:// or https://
creator.lockedHand: When this is played (it works from the enemy's hand)
creator.lockedHelp: Every {template} has this ability. Leave it without effects if the card should do nothing when played; add more abilities below for follow-ups, Faith and the like.
creator.lockedRemoveHelp: Only a few hidden official cards have no “when played” ability
creator.lorePlaceholder: A line of story or a quote, like the lore on official cards. Not rules.
creator.madeByCard: A card made by another card
creator.maskRemoveConfirm: Remove the pop-out mask from this card?
creator.maskSaved: Pop-out mask saved with the card.
creator.maskSize: A mask must be {size} × {size} pixels, the same as the artwork (this one is {w} × {h}). Start from the blank mask in the artwork guide.
creator.maskStateHas: This card has a pop-out mask.
creator.maskStateNone: Without a mask the whole picture stays inside the frame.
creator.minusAllies: Count friendly units against it (count minus allies)
creator.myCardsHelp: Your drafts and the cards you submitted. Only you can see your drafts.
creator.name: Name
creator.nameFirst: Give the card a name first.
creator.nativeHint: As of the last save. Fields the card leaves empty are hidden.
creator.nativeSaveFirst: Save the card to see it in the game's layout.
creator.noFilterNote: The game takes this card (or the warlord) directly and never checks these filters, so they do nothing here. They are only kept because some official cards carry them.
creator.noRulesYet: No rules have been written yet.
creator.notCardsWithTheSameName: Not cards with the same name
creator.notes: Notes for the reviewer (not shown on the card)
creator.notesPlaceholder: Anything the abilities above cannot express, balance thoughts, art ideas…
creator.oldCondition: This ability still has an old free-text condition the game never read ("{text}"). It is dropped when the card is saved; use the ability's "when" settings for a real condition.
creator.oneAction: A card has only one action. Remove the current one first.
creator.onlyOnKind: Official cards only have this on {kind} cards.
creator.onlyWhileThisCardIsInPlay: Only while this card is in play
creator.orphanPickHelp: This card names a pick, but none of its abilities aims at the picked unit (as a few official cards).
creator.otherActionExists: This card already has a different action (see Action below); a card has only one.
creator.ownCardReview: your own card – someone else has to approve it
creator.pickAction: What the player picks for the action
creator.pickActionAdd: + Say what the player picks for the action
creator.pickCard: What the player picks when playing the card
creator.pickCardAdd: + Say what the player picks when playing the card
creator.pickFromList: Pick a card from the list.
creator.pickHelp: Effects aimed at “a unit the player picks” act on this unit; “the picked unit, only if it also matches” narrows it further.
creator.pickIt: What the player picks for it
creator.pickItAdd: + Say what the player picks for it
creator.pickNone: The player picks nothing: "the chosen target" is what the event hit
creator.pickNoneHelp: Nothing is picked when the card is played; effects aimed at "the chosen target" act on the unit the trigger is about.
creator.pickNote: The game does not check these ticks on “the chosen target”: that is the unit the player picked (set in “What the player picks”), or, on triggers where nothing is picked, the unit the event is about (narrowed with the ability’s “Only when the event hit certain units”). They are only kept because some official cards carry them. To act only when that unit matches more (e.g. “if it is a Vehicle”), aim the effect at “the target, if it matches” and use its filter.
creator.pickOne: The player picks one of these
creator.prayStateLong: The praying state, as on every official Pray card (the server adds it to a Pray card that has none).
creator.prayStateShort: Also gives the praying state when it prays, as every official Pray card does.
creator.randomEffect: Pick one of the effects at random
creator.removeKeywordOnlyHelp: The ability stays, as a custom ability; a few official cards have the ability without the keyword
creator.reviewQueueHelp: Every submitted card from every author. Visible to reviewers and admins only.
creator.samePick: Uses the same pick as {ability} (one pick per card).
creator.savedDraft: saved as a draft – only you can see it
creator.settingsHelp: Rarely needed: settings a few official cards use. Left blank, the usual rule applies.
creator.signInToSee: Sign in to see your cards.
creator.stHelp: A stratagem's type is a label. Other cards use it to find a family of stratagems (“create a random Rune”), and a few types are handled outside the deck. Use Normal unless your card should belong to one of these families.
creator.stLoadFailed: The stratagem type list could not be loaded.
creator.stSource: Counts, factions and deck use are from the game's card data (1,351 cards). The descriptions are read from the cards and the fan rulebook and have not been traced through the game's code.
creator.stUnused: In the game but used by no official card, so untested: {list}.
creator.stratagemType: Stratagem type (a family other cards can name)
creator.subjectBack: Back to the usual cards for this trigger
creator.subjectFiltered: A card matching the filter below
creator.subjectHelp: Tick who counts: e.g. "Enemy" + "Troops" + "Warlords" = when an enemy unit does it (Invictor Warsuit). In the effects below, "The card that caused the trigger" means that card.
creator.subjectSet: Say which cards set it off
creator.subjectToggle: Only when set off by certain cards (“Triggered by”) …
creator.subjectUsual: Triggered by: the usual cards for this trigger (as most official cards).
creator.targetsCounter: Show a count of its targets on the card in hand
creator.templateText.defence: The card a deck uses when it goes second, picked in the deck editor's own slot.
creator.templateText.enchantment: A hidden card another card attaches with an “Attach an enchantment” buff. Its abilities act for the card it is attached to; its cost, stats and text are not used. Battlefield effects (turn start or end, earning a skull) are enchantments.
creator.templateText.hero: The warlord a deck is built around.
creator.templateText.offence: A card the player going first can pick at the start of a battle. Effects that last all battle (weather, turn start or end, skulls) go on an Enchantment card that this one attaches.
creator.templateText.sabotage: A card another card puts into the enemy's hand. Its abilities work while it sits in that hand (e.g. at the end of the turn), like Poisoned Supplies.
creator.templateText.stratagem: A card the player puts in a deck and plays. It always has a “When this is played” ability; more can follow it (follow-ups, Faith, Oath ...).
creator.templateText.talent: A card a warlord's Talent adds to the hand. Created by a card, always Ephemeral (all 92 official ones are). Give your warlord a Talent ability that adds this card.
creator.templateText.troop: A unit that is deployed to the battlefield.
creator.thePlayerWaitsUntilItHasResolved: The player waits until it has resolved
creator.tickRules: Tick the box to confirm the card follows the rules before submitting. Saving a draft does not need it.
creator.tokenHelp: Created by another card only – not in the collection and cannot be put in a deck. Tick this for a stratagem or troop that another card adds to your hand or summons.
creator.trig.Hand.WhileInPlayVariable: Its cost follows a count while in hand
creator.trigGroup.after: Straight after it is played (it waits in the graveyard)
creator.trigGroup.enemyHand: While it is in the enemy's hand
creator.trigGroup.hand: While it is in your hand
creator.trigText.Hand.WhileInPlayVariabl: A cost that changes with a count while the card waits in your hand, e.g. “costs 1 less if you control a unit with Stealth”.
creator.troopPlayIsRally: On official troops a "when played" ability is always a Rally ability. To make this one Rally, add the Rally keyword instead.

decks.copyBlocked: Your browser did not allow copying, so the code is in the import box below – copy it from there.
decks.help: The decks saved on your linked game account. Copy code or Download a deck to share it or keep a backup; anyone can import it here or in the game. These are the game's own deck codes: in the game, Import Deck on the decks screen takes a code from here, and a deck's Share button copies one you can paste below.
decks.importHelp: Paste a deck code, or choose a deck file. The deck is added as a new deck – nothing you already have is replaced. Decks imported here show up in the game the next time the game starts; to get one straight away, paste the code into the game's own Import Deck box instead.
decks.imported: {name} added to your {mode} decks. It appears in the game the next time the game starts.
decks.none: No decks saved yet. Build one in the game, or import one below.
decks.notACode: that is not a deck code. Use Copy code here, or the Share button on a deck in the game
decks.title: Your decks
decks.unlinked: Your decks show here once this account is linked to your game: open the game, go to Settings > Account, and sign in with this username and password.
footer.noGame: The game itself is not provided by this project: players install their own copy. The project runs a replacement server and a mod so the game keeps working now that its official servers are closed. The project makes no money.
footer.takedown: If any of your work appears here without your permission, let us know at {email} and we'll take it down. Questions are welcome there too.

home.termsHint: - the rules, what the server keeps, and deleting your account
home.unofficial: An unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Everguild or Games Workshop. You need your own copy of the game.
login.agree: I am 16 or older and I agree to the {terms}.
login.createIntro: Pick a username and a password. That is all an account needs.
login.createdNeedsApproval: Account created. An admin has to approve it before you can use the site or play. Sign in again once it is approved.
login.createdWaits: Account created. Welcome, {name}. An admin has to approve it before you can play or use the Card Creator; meanwhile the guides and your profile are open.
login.deletionCancelled: Welcome back. Your account will not be deleted after all.
login.intro: Sign in to design cards for Warpforge Revival.
login.needsApproval: An admin has to approve it before you can use the site or play. Sign in again once it is approved.
login.noMatch: The two passwords do not match.
login.rules: Username: 5 to 30 letters, digits, . ' - or _, no spaces. Password: at least 6 characters, no spaces. Do not reuse a password from another site. This is the same account you can link in the game under Settings > Account.
login.termsChanged: The Terms and Privacy notice have changed since you last signed in. Read them, tick the box and sign in again.
login.tickTerms: Tick the box to agree to the Terms and Privacy notice.
login.unreachable: The server could not be reached: {error}
login.willBeDeleted: Your account will be deleted on {date}. You have been signed out everywhere. To keep the account, sign in again before then.
profile.artDone: Card art loaded from your game's export. It stays in this browser.
profile.artNoText: no card text (export again with mod 0.13.19 or later)
profile.artNotKept: The card art is shown, but this browser would not keep it: pick the file again next time.
profile.artNotLoaded: Not loaded: cards show without pictures
profile.cardArt: Card art and text from your game
profile.cardArtHelp: The pictures come from your own copy of the game, never from this server. In the game, open Settings > Mod and press Export card art. It saves card-art-export.zip in the game's folder, under UserData\WarpforgeRevival (Steam: right-click the game > Manage > Browse local files). Then pick that file here. It stays in this browser only: nothing is uploaded. The Card viewer and other pages draw official cards with it, with their names, rules and lore in any of the game's languages (exports from mod 0.13.19 on); without it they show cards without pictures. Step by step for Windows and Android: {guide}.
profile.deleteExact: Type your username exactly as it is to confirm.
profile.deleteHelp: Signs you out of the website and the game everywhere at once, and deletes the account after 7 days. Signing in again with your password before then cancels it. Your game player (decks, progress, friends, recordings), drafts and rejected cards are deleted. Approved cards stay in the game, credited to “deleted account”, and your chat messages still kept are emptied. See the {terms}.
profile.deleteNeed: Enter your password and type your username.
profile.discordDoneNoMfa: Two-factor sign-in is off on that Discord account: password resets through Discord will need it.
profile.discordHelp: Linking your Discord account to this one lets our Discord server know who you are here. If you lose your password and recovery code, type /password-reset in our Discord server: after a short wait the bot shows you a one-time reset code (it needs two-factor sign-in on your Discord account). /account there shows which account your Discord is linked to. Your roles here (Approved, Tester, Reviewer, Admin) show in our Discord too. You do not sign in with Discord; we only see your Discord username and whether it has two-factor sign-in on. Your password is asked to link or unlink.
profile.discordLinkAsk: Discord asks you to allow WF-Revival to see your username, then sends you back here.
profile.discordMfaOff: Two-factor sign-in on Discord: off (it will be needed for password resets through Discord; switch it on in Discord, then link again).
profile.discordResetAsked: A password reset was asked for through Discord. {when} If that was not you, cancel it now and change your password. {cancel}
profile.discordResetAt: The code is shown on Discord at {time}.
profile.discordResetWarn: A password reset was asked for through Discord. If that was not you, cancel it on your Profile page (Discord section) now.
profile.discordUnavailable: Discord linking is not available on this server yet.
profile.discordUnlinkAsk: Your Discord account will no longer be linked to this account.
profile.gameLoginDone: {file} downloaded. Any earlier file no longer works.
profile.gameLoginHelp: A game login file lets the game sign in as this game account without Steam – for another computer, or when Steam is not working – so you keep your decks and progress. Put the file in the game's folder under UserData\WarpforgeRevival\ and start the game. While the file is there the game always signs in with it.
profile.gameLoginNeed: Enter your password to make the file.
profile.gameLoginNormally: You normally do not need it: signing in from the game's own sign-in window writes this file for you. Treat it like a password: anyone who has the file can play as you. Changing your password cancels every file and game sign-in at once; signing out in the game cancels that computer's or device's. {when}
profile.gameSignIns: Game sign-ins active: {count}; the latest made on {date}.
profile.noAdminAsksCode: No admin will ever ask you for your recovery code or a password reset code. Anyone who asks for one is trying to take over your account. Do not send it, and tell us at {email}.
profile.noAdminAsksFile: No admin will ever ask you for your game login file. Anyone who asks for it is trying to take over your account. Do not send it, and tell us at {email}.
profile.noGameSignIn: The game has not been signed in with this account yet.
profile.noResetWaiting: There was no reset waiting (it may already have been shown).
profile.notLinked: Not linked to a game account. To link, open the game and go to Settings > Account, then enter this username and password.
profile.passChanged: Password changed. Other browsers signed in to this account have been signed out.
profile.passNeed: Enter your current password and the new one.
profile.passwordRules: At least 6 characters, no spaces. Changing it signs this account out everywhere except here.
profile.recoveryDone: Recovery code made and downloaded. Any earlier code no longer works.
profile.recoveryFileHow: If you forget your password: open the website, choose "Forgot your password?" and enter your username, this code and a new password.
profile.recoveryFileOnce: The code works once. Anyone with it can take over your account, so keep this file private.
profile.recoveryHelp: If you forget your password, a recovery code lets you set a new one from the sign-in page (Forgot your password?). It is shown only once and downloaded as a file: keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer if you can. Anyone with the code and your username can take over the account. Making a new code cancels the old one, and using a code uses it up. {when}
profile.recoveryMade: You have a recovery code, made on {date}.
profile.recoveryNeed: Enter your password to make a recovery code.
profile.recoveryNone: You do not have a recovery code.
profile.recoveryRemake: Make a new code (cancels the old one)
profile.recoveryRemoveAsk: Remove your recovery code? Without one there is no way back in if you forget your password.
profile.recoveryRemoveNeed: Enter your password to remove your recovery code.
profile.recoveryRemoved: Recovery code removed. The old code no longer works.
profile.recoveryShownOnce: It has also been downloaded. It will not be shown again.
profile.renameNeed: Enter the new username and your password.
profile.resetCancelled: Password reset cancelled. No code will be made. If you did not ask for it, change your password.
profile.usernameRules: 5 to 30 letters, digits, . ' - or _, no spaces. Your cards keep following you under the new name. In-game display names are separate and are not changed by this.
profile.waiting: Your account is waiting for an admin to approve it. Until then you can read the guides and look after your account here (username, password, recovery code). The game and the Card Creator open once it is approved: sign in to the game then with this username and password.
recover.doneRecovery: Password reset. Welcome back, {name}. Your recovery code is used up: make a new one on your Profile page.
recover.doneReset: Password reset. Welcome back, {name}. Make a recovery code on your Profile page so you can do this yourself next time.
recover.intro: Use the recovery code you saved from your Profile page, or a reset code an admin gave you. It works once: afterwards, make a new recovery code on your Profile page.
recover.needAll: Enter your username, your recovery code and a new password.
recover.noMatch: The two new passwords do not match.
recover.signsOut: Resetting signs this account out of every browser, computer and Android device.
recover.title: Reset your password
replay.madeCard: a card made during the match
replays.copyByHand: Copy did not work: select the code and copy it by hand.
replays.copyLinkTip: A link that opens this match as text on this site
replays.lookupHelp: Someone shared a code with you? Look it up, or read the match as text.
replays.matchesHelp: Your game's battle log, newest first, and the replay codes you made (a code keeps working after its match leaves the battle log). View as text lists who played what, turn by turn, from the recording on the server. To make a code, press CODE next to a match in the game's battle log (Profile). Card names come from your own game's card export (Profile > Card art and text from your game); without it, cards show by their id.
replays.noMatches: No matches in your battle log yet.
replays.noRecording: No recording on the server for this match.
replays.notInLog: no longer in your battle log
replays.removeAsk: Remove replay code {code}? Anyone who has it will no longer be able to watch this match.
replays.sharedBy: Shared by {name}. To watch it, copy the code and press Watch a replay code in the game under Settings > Mod.
replays.unlinked: Your matches show here once this account is linked to your game: open the game, go to Settings > Account, and sign in with this username and password. You can still look up a replay code below.
replays.unnamed: This recording was made before the mod sent card lists with recordings, so cards show by their in-match number.
